title: Flatness of the canonical finite-coefficient realization
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $A$ a finite commutative ring. If $M$ is a flat sheaf of $A$-modules [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] on $X_{proet}$, its canonical realization [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], followed by restriction along the commutative constant-ring comparison [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact], is flat as a sheaf of modules over the constant commutative ring sheaf.

source.place: Tags 03CY and 03DA; constant scalar presentation and flatness under the module equivalence

proof.text: Construct the associated-module-sheaf adjunction unit. The equations identifying the constant-ring comparison on constant sections show it is linear for constant scalars. Its underlying additive morphism is the sheafification unit of the original additive sheaf, hence invertible. The restriction of the realized module is therefore isomorphic to the given flat sheaf. Apply the flatness equivalence for constant-scalar restriction [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor].

proof_origin.place: Tags 03CY and 03DA; unit of associated module sheafification and constant scalar restriction

theorem finiteCoefficientRealization_flat
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (M : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (hM : ObjectProperty.flat M) :
    letI : TopologicalSpace A := ⊥
    letI : DiscreteTopology A := ⟨rfl⟩
    SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
      (R := finiteCoefficientCommRing A T)
      ((finiteCoefficientRealization T A ⋙
        SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (finiteCoefficientCommRingComparison A T)).obj M)
